item.title: Mississippi State University visited by British consul general

item.title: Thunder & Lightning: Mississippi State Has a Massive Opportunity in Texas This Weekend
item.description: Mississippi State has cruised to a 9-0 start, but starting today, the price of poker goes up for the Diamond Dawgs. Brian Hadad and Robbie Faulk preview the Amegy Bank College Baseball Series, paying extra attention to the opener with Arizona State and the finale with the nation’s #1 team, UCLA.
